tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search mitbbs.ai Chinese-language news headlines and forum posts (guest-readable boards only). Returns url, title, excerpt, board, author, posted_at, source_name, source_url, rights_basis per result.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Read a story thread: topic metadata plus the site own summary. Summary-only for every rights basis (owner ruling 2026-11-08): post full text is never served; posts is always empty. Includes rights_basis, source_url and provenance (content SHA256).

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: List public forum boards (id, name, description, topic/post counts, url).

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Look up curated entities (people, companies, places, topics) tracked by mitbbs.ai. Pass q to search, or id (stable_id) for a profile.

tools.name: market_quote
tools.description: Unified market quote: US stock (NVDA), forex pair (USD_CNY or USD/CNY), or crypto (BTC or bitcoin). Data delayed 15 minutes; reference only, not investment advice.

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Current weather + 7-day forecast for 16 cities (Chinese + English). Source: Open-Meteo (CC-BY 4.0).

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: Convert an amount between currencies (ECB reference rates). Supported: USD, CNY, EUR, JPY, GBP, CAD, AUD, HKD, TWD, KRW. Note: TWD has no ECB rate and returns null.

tools.name: yellow_pages
tools.description: Search 4,389+ NYC Chinese business listings by keyword or category (Chinese).

tools.name: visa_info
tools.description: US visa/immigration policy info in Chinese (F-1, H-1B, EB-1/2/3/5, family, N-400) with Visa Bulletin priority dates. Reference only — not legal advice.

tools.name: travel_guide
tools.description: Chinese-language travel guides for overseas Chinese: 10 US cities, 8 countries/regions, 3 NYC day trips. Overview, sights, food, transport, best season, tips for Chinese travelers.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_story" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_news, get_story, list_boards · Public sink: get_story, list_boards.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_news, get_story, list_boards · Public sink: get_story, list_boards

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_story" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read a story thread: topic metadata plus paginated posts (oldest first). Includes rights_basis and canonical url." → after: "Read a story thread: topic metadata plus the site own summary. Summary-only for every rights basis (owner ruling 2026-11-08): post full text is never served; posts is always empty. Includes rights_basis, source_url and provenance (content SHA256)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
